post.title: Photo studios charge a fortune for passport photos. Photo4Cents: free.
post.caption: One fresh grudge: photo studios charging ridiculous prices for two tiny headshots, replaced by a free browser tool and one 4x6 print.

segments.gripe: Photo studios, charging a fortune for two tiny headshots.
segments.quote: Photo4Cents helps you make passport photos without paying those ridiculous prices at photo studios.

cues.say: [sarcastic] Photo for Cents helps you make passport photos

cues.cap: So: one 4x6 print at any lab.
cues.say: [quick] So: one four-by-six print, at any lab.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
